notes: UAlbertaBot by David Churchill, the reference bot many others (Steamhammer, Locutus) grew from: rushes from its config (zealot, marine, zergling), then plans its build with the BOSS build-order search and decides its fights with the SparCraft combat simulator; registered as UAlbertaBotProtoss, UAlbertaBotTerran and UAlbertaBotZerg
